title: षट्त्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Bhima argues that time is running out and that excessive gentleness is a fault in a king. He suggests that by the Soma rite a month can count as a year, and urges Yudhishthira to resolve on slaying his enemies, the only dharma of a kshatriya.
summary.kn: ಸಮಯ ಕಳೆಯುತ್ತಿದೆ, ಅತಿಯಾದ ಮೃದುತ್ವ ರಾಜನಿಗೆ ದೋಷ ಎಂದು ಭೀಮನು ವಾದಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಸೋಮಯಾಗದಿಂದ ಒಂದು ತಿಂಗಳು ಒಂದು ವರ್ಷವಾಗಬಹುದೆಂದು ಸೂಚಿಸಿ, ಕ್ಷತ್ರಿಯನ ಏಕೈಕ ಧರ್ಮವಾದ ಶತ್ರುವಧೆಗೆ ನಿಶ್ಚಯಿಸೆಂದು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಾಯಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: भीम तर्क देते हैं कि समय बीत रहा है और अत्यधिक कोमलता राजा का दोष है। वे सुझाते हैं कि सोम-याग से एक मास एक वर्ष के बराबर हो सकता है, और युधिष्ठिर से शत्रुओं के वध का निश्चय करने का आग्रह करते हैं, जो क्षत्रिय का एकमात्र धर्म है।
summary.te: సమయం గడిచిపోతోందని, అతి మృదుత్వం రాజుకు దోషమని భీముడు వాదిస్తాడు. సోమయాగంతో ఒక నెల ఒక సంవత్సరంగా లెక్కించవచ్చని సూచించి, క్షత్రియుని ఏకైక ధర్మమైన శత్రుసంహారానికి నిశ్చయించమని యుధిష్ఠిరుని కోరతాడు.
summary.ta: காலம் கடந்துகொண்டிருக்கிறது, அளவுக்கு மீறிய மென்மை மன்னனுக்குக் குறை என்று பீமன் வாதிடுகிறான். ஸோம யாகத்தால் ஒரு மாதம் ஓராண்டாகக் கொள்ளப்படலாம் என்று சொல்லி, க்ஷத்ரியனின் ஒரே கடமையான பகைவரைக் கொல்வதைத் தீர்மானிக்குமாறு யுதிஷ்டிரரை வற்புறுத்துகிறான்.
summary.ml: സമയം കഴിയുന്നുവെന്നും അമിതമായ സൗമ്യത രാജാവിന്റെ കുറ്റമാണെന്നും ഭീമൻ വാദിക്കുന്നു. സോമയാഗത്തിലൂടെ ഒരു മാസം ഒരു വർഷമായി കണക്കാക്കാമെന്ന് അദ്ദേഹം നിർദ്ദേശിക്കുന്നു; ശത്രുക്കളെ വധിക്കാൻ ദൃഢനിശ്ചയം ചെയ്യാനും അതാണ് ക്ഷത്രിയന്റെ ഏകധർമ്മമെന്നും അദ്ദേഹം യുധിഷ്ഠിരനോട് ആവശ്യപ്പെടുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.36; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: भीमसेन उवाच

meaning.en: Bhimasena said:

verses.text:
संधिं कृत्वैव कालेन अन्तकेन पतत्रिणा ।
अनन्तेनाप्रमेयेन स्रोतसा सर्वहारिणा ॥

meaning.en: "Having made a pact with Time, the Ender, the bird, the endless, immeasurable current that carries off everything,"

verses.text:
प्रत्यक्षं मन्यसे कालं मर्त्यः सन्कालबन्धनः ।
फेनधर्मा महाराज फलधर्मा तथैव च ॥

meaning.en: "you consider Time as visible, though a mortal bound by time, king, whose nature is like foam, and also like fruit that ripens."

verses.text:
निमेषादपि कौन्तेय यस्यायुरपचीयते ।
सूच्येवाञ्जनचूर्णस्य किमिति प्रतिपालयेत् ॥

meaning.en: "Son of Kunti, whose life is shortened even by the blink of an eye, like a needle moving through a heap of collyrium, why should he wait?"

verses.text:
यो नूनममितायुः स्यादथ वापि प्रमाणवित् ।
स कालं वै प्रतीक्षेत सर्वप्रत्यक्षदर्शिवान् ॥

meaning.en: "One who surely has unlimited life, or knows the measure of things, might wait for time, being one who sees all directly."

verses.text:
प्रतीक्षमाणान्कालो नः समा राजंस्त्रयोदश ।
आयुषोऽपचयं कृत्वा मरणायोपनेष्यति ॥

meaning.en: "For us who wait, king, Time will bring thirteen years, shortening our life, and lead us to death."

verses.text:
शरीरिणां हि मरणं शरीरे नित्यमाश्रितम् ।
प्रागेव मरणात्तस्माद्राज्यायैव घटामहे ॥

meaning.en: "For embodied beings, death is always lodged in the body; so before death comes, let us strive for the kingdom."

verses.text:
यो न याति प्रसंख्यानमस्पष्टो भूमिवर्धनः ।
अयातयित्वा वैराणि सोऽवसीदति गौरिव ॥

meaning.en: "A man who does not go to repay, indistinct, and increase the earth, without avenging enmities, sinks like a cow."

verses.text:
यो न यातयते वैरमल्पसत्त्वोद्यमः पुमान् ।
अफलं तस्य जन्माहं मन्ये दुर्जातजायिनः ॥

meaning.en: "A man of little courage and effort who does not avenge enmity, I think his birth is fruitless, born an evil birth."

verses.text:
हैरण्यौ भवतो बाहू श्रुतिर्भवति पार्थिव ।
हत्वा द्विषन्तं संग्रामे भुक्त्वा बाह्वर्जितं वसु ॥

meaning.en: "Your arms are golden, king, and so says the revelation: having slain the enemy in battle, enjoy the wealth won by your arms."

verses.text:
हत्वा चेत्पुरुषो राजन्निकर्तारमरिंदम ।
अह्नाय नरकं गच्छेत्स्वर्गेणास्य स संमितः ॥

meaning.en: "If a man, O king, scourge of enemies, kills his betrayer, though he go to hell at once, it is counted as equal to heaven for him."

verses.text:
अमर्षजो हि संतापः पावकाद्दीप्तिमत्तरः ।
येनाहमभिसंतप्तो न नक्तं न दिवा शये ॥

meaning.en: "The burning that is born of anger is brighter than fire, by which I am scorched, and I sleep neither night nor day."

verses.text:
अयं च पार्थो बीभत्सुर्वरिष्ठो ज्याविकर्षणे ।
आस्ते परमसंतप्तो नूनं सिंह इवाशये ॥

meaning.en: "And this Partha Bibhatsu, the best at drawing the bowstring, sits intensely tormented, surely like a lion in his lair."

verses.text:
योऽयमेकोऽभिमनुते सर्वाँल्लोके धनुर्भृतः ।
सोऽयमात्मजमूष्माणं महाहस्तीव यच्छति ॥

meaning.en: "He who alone thinks he can face all the bowmen in the world suppresses his own heat like a great elephant."

verses.text:
नकुलः सहदेवश्च वृद्धा माता च वीरसूः ।
तवैव प्रियमिच्छन्त आसते जडमूकवत् ॥

meaning.en: "Nakula and Sahadeva, and the old mother of heroes, sit like dull mutes wishing only your pleasure."

verses.text:
सर्वे ते प्रियमिच्छन्ति बान्धवाः सह सृञ्जयैः ।
अहमेकोऽभिसंतप्तो माता च प्रतिविन्ध्यतः ॥

meaning.en: "All your kinsmen, with the Srinjayas, wish to please you; only I am deeply burning, and so is Prativindhya's mother, Draupadi."

verses.text:
प्रियमेव तु सर्वेषां यद्ब्रवीम्युत किंचन ।
सर्वे ही व्यसनं प्राप्ताः सर्वे युद्धाभिनन्दिनः ॥

meaning.en: "Whatever I say is for the pleasure of all of them; all have fallen into misfortune and all rejoice in war."

verses.text:
नेतः पापीयसी काचिदापद्राजन्भविष्यति ।
यन्नो नीचैरल्पबलै राज्यमाच्छिद्य भुज्यते ॥

meaning.en: "There will be no calamity worse than this, king, that our kingdom is taken and enjoyed by low, weak men."

verses.text:
शीलदोषाद्घृणाविष्ट आनृशंस्यात्परंतप ।
क्लेशांस्तितिक्षसे राजन्नान्यः कश्चित्प्रशंसति ॥

meaning.en: "Out of a fault of character, seized by pity and by kindliness, scorcher of enemies, you endure afflictions; no one else praises it."

verses.text:
घृणी ब्राह्मणरूपोऽसि कथं क्षत्रे अजायथाः ।
अस्यां हि योनौ जायन्ते प्रायशः क्रूरबुद्धयः ॥

meaning.en: "You are tender, a brahmin in form; how were you born a warrior? In this womb, mostly cruel-minded men are born."

verses.text:
अश्रौषीस्त्वं राजधर्मान्यथा वै मनुरब्रवीत् ।
क्रूरान्निकृतिसंयुक्तान्विहितानशमात्मकान् ॥

meaning.en: "You have heard the duties of kings as Manu taught them: that they are cruel, joined with deceit, and are not peaceful."

verses.text:
कर्तव्ये पुरुषव्याघ्र किमास्से पीठसर्पवत् ।
बुद्ध्या वीर्येण संयुक्तः श्रुतेनाभिजनेन च ॥

meaning.en: "Tiger among men, when action is needed, why do you sit like a cripple dragging on a seat, you who have wisdom, valor, learning and good birth?"

verses.text:
तृणानां मुष्टिनैकेन हिमवन्तं तु पर्वतम् ।
छन्नमिच्छसि कौन्तेय योऽस्मान्संवर्तुमिच्छसि ॥

meaning.en: "Son of Kunti, you wish to hide the Himalaya mountain with a handful of straw, you who wish to keep us hidden."

verses.text:
अज्ञातचर्या गूढेन पृथिव्यां विश्रुतेन च ।
दिवीव पार्थ सूर्येण न शक्या चरितुं त्वया ॥

meaning.en: "Partha, a person famed in the world cannot live in hiding, as the sun cannot in the sky."

verses.text:
बृहच्छाल इवानूपे शाखापुष्पपलाशवान् ।
हस्ती श्वेत इवाज्ञातः कथं जिष्णुश्चरिष्यति ॥

meaning.en: "How will Jishnu live unknown, like a great sal tree in a marsh with branches, blossoms and leaves, or a white elephant?"

verses.text:
इमौ च सिंहसंकाशौ भ्रातरौ सहितौ शिशू ।
नकुलः सहदेवश्च कथं पार्थ चरिष्यतः ॥

meaning.en: "How will these two lionlike brothers, the young twins Nakula and Sahadeva, go about, Partha?"

verses.text:
पुण्यकीर्ती राजपुत्री द्रौपदी वीरसूरियम् ।
विश्रुता कथमज्ञाता कृष्णा पार्थ चरिष्यति ॥

meaning.en: "How will this princess Draupadi, of holy fame and mother of heroes, famed, live unrecognized, Partha?"

verses.text:
मां चापि राजञ्जानन्ति आकुमारमिमाः प्रजाः ।
अज्ञातचर्यां पश्यामि मेरोरिव निगूहनम् ॥

meaning.en: "And these people have known me, king, from boyhood; I see an unknown life as impossible as hiding Mount Meru."

verses.text:
तथैव बहवोऽस्माभी राष्ट्रेभ्यो विप्रवासिताः ।
राजानो राजपुत्राश्च धृतराष्ट्रमनुव्रताः ॥

meaning.en: "Likewise many kings and princes loyal to Dhritarashtra were banished by us from their lands."

verses.text:
न हि तेऽप्युपशाम्यन्ति निकृतानां निराकृताः ।
अवश्यं तैर्निकर्तव्यमस्माकं तत्प्रियैषिभिः ॥

meaning.en: "They too, being slighted and wronged, do not calm down; those who wish him well will surely work some cheating against us."

verses.text:
तेऽप्यस्मासु प्रयुञ्जीरन्प्रच्छन्नान्सुबहूञ्जनान् ।
आचक्षीरंश्च नो ज्ञात्वा तन्नः स्यात्सुमहद्भयम् ॥

meaning.en: "They would also send many hidden people against us and, discovering us, would report us, and a very great danger would come to us."

verses.text:
अस्माभिरुषिताः सम्यग्वने मासास्त्रयोदश ।
परिमाणेन तान्पश्य तावतः परिवत्सरान् ॥

meaning.en: "We have lived properly in the forest thirteen months; consider them to count as that many years."

verses.text:
अस्ति मासः प्रतिनिधिर्यथा प्राहुर्मनीषिणः ।
पूतिकानिव सोमस्य तथेदं क्रियतामिति ॥

meaning.en: "There is a substitute, as the wise say: as for Soma, so for this, let it be done: putika plants take the place of the real."

verses.text:
अथ वानडुहे राजन्साधवे साधुवाहिने ।
सौहित्यदानादेकस्मादेनसः प्रतिमुच्यते ॥

meaning.en: "Or by giving a good-natured, well-pulling bull a full meal, one is freed from the sin."

verses.text:
तस्माच्छत्रुवधे राजन्क्रियतां निश्चयस्त्वया ।
क्षत्रियस्य तु सर्वस्य नान्यो धर्मोऽस्ति संयुगात् ॥

meaning.en: "So, O king, make your resolve to kill your enemies; for all warriors, no dharma exists other than battle."
